content.title: About
content.content: The fruit flavored drink comes as a powder designed for quick preparation of a refreshing beverage with a high vitamin C content. The powder dissolves in water to create a low‑calorie diet drink suitable for those monitoring sugar intake.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: The powdered format allows long‑term storage without loss of vitamins.
Vitamin C remains active after drying thanks to micro‑encapsulation technology.
The product is easy to transport and use on trips, at work, or while camping.
Sugar content is minimal; sweetness is achieved with natural sweeteners.
The drink can be prepared hot or cold, offering different taste experiences.

items.title: High vitamin C content
items.content: Vitamin C supports the immune system, aids collagen synthesis, and acts as an antioxidant.

items.title: Low calorie
items.content: The diet drink provides few calories, helping to maintain energy balance.

items.title: Hydration
items.content: A soluble drink helps replenish body fluids, especially in hot weather or after exercise.

items.title: No artificial colors
items.content: Only natural extracts are used for coloring, reducing the risk of allergic reactions.

items.title: Convenient to use
items.content: The powder dissolves quickly in water without the need for special equipment.

items.title: Allergy to fruit extracts
items.content: Some individuals may experience allergic reactions to flavor components.

items.title: Excessive vitamin C intake
items.content: Very high doses of vitamin C can cause gastrointestinal discomfort.

items.title: Storage in high humidity
items.content: Powder may clump and lose efficacy if kept in a damp environment.

items.title: Not recommended for children under 3
items.content: Due to the risk of accidental over‑consumption of the powder.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: Mix one serving (typically 10 g) with 200–250 ml of cold or warm water, stir thoroughly until fully dissolved. Optionally add a slice of lemon or a sprig of mint for extra flavor.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Store in a cool, dry place, tightly sealed. After opening, use within 3 months for best quality.
